Legal

Warranty

Summary only. Your signed contract controls. Have counsel review this page before launch.

1-year workmanship warranty

ADU America warrants its workmanship for one year from completion. If a defect in our work appears during that period, we will repair it at no charge to you.

Manufacturer warranties

Materials and equipment such as windows, roofing, flooring, appliances and HVAC carry their own manufacturer warranties. We pass those along to you at completion.

Not covered

Normal wear, damage from misuse or neglect, changes made by others, and conditions outside our scope are not covered. Natural movement and minor settling are normal in new construction.

Making a claim

Email admin@adu-america.com or call (720) 544-1352 with your address and a description, with photos if you can.
